_comment: What a configuration needs on someone else's phone, for readiness.py.  Data, not code.
'access' names the special access an action can need: what it is called, and what the person
receiving the file has to do about it.  These are the things Tasker itself cannot ask for when
the file is imported.  Ordinary runtime permissions (location, SMS, contacts, ...) are left out
on purpose: Tasker lists those itself when a Project is imported.
'items' is keyed like actionc.action_codes: the Tasker code plus t (action), e (event) or s (state).
'needs'  each entry is one requirement.  'a|b|c' means ANY ONE of them will do, which is how
Tasker works for most of these -- Kill App runs with root, ADB Wifi, Device Owner
or Shizuku, whichever the phone has.
'when'   an argument that has to hold one of the listed integer values for 'needs' to apply
('arg1': [0, 1, 2] -- Show Scene, Display As one of the three overlay modes).
'since'  the first Tasker release that has the item, from the release notes at
https://tasker.joaoapps.com/changes.html.  Absent means older than the 5.x notes, i.e.
present in every Tasker still in use.
'by_argument' is the structural rule: an action carrying one of these switches, turned on, needs
that access whatever the action is.  Twelve actions have a Use Root switch, and finding them by
the switch means a new one is covered without an entry here.
This is a floor, not a guarantee.  An action with no entry is not known to need nothing -- it is
just not known.  Every code below is checked against actionc by tests/test_readiness.py, so a
typo or a renamed action fails there rather than silently reading as 'no requirement'.

root.label: Root
root.how: The phone has to be rooted, and Tasker granted root when it asks.

adb_wifi.label: ADB Wi-Fi
adb_wifi.how: Wireless debugging turned on and paired on the phone, so Tasker can run commands that normally need root.

write_secure_settings.label: Write Secure Settings
write_secure_settings.how: Granted once from a computer: adb shell pm grant net.dinglisch.android.taskerm android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS

read_logs.label: Read Logs
read_logs.how: Granted once from a computer: adb shell pm grant net.dinglisch.android.taskerm android.permission.READ_LOGS

shizuku.label: Shizuku
shizuku.how: The Shizuku app installed and running, with Tasker allowed to use it.

tasker_settings.label: Tasker Settings app
tasker_settings.how: The separate Tasker Settings app installed on the phone.

device_owner.label: Device Admin/Owner
device_owner.how: Tasker set up as Device Admin or Device Owner, which is done once from a computer.

accessibility.label: Accessibility service
accessibility.how: Tasker's accessibility service switched on in Android Settings.

notification_access.label: Notification access
notification_access.how: Tasker allowed under Android Settings, Notification access.

dnd_access.label: Do Not Disturb access
dnd_access.how: Tasker allowed under Android Settings, Do Not Disturb access.

overlay.label: Display over other apps
overlay.how: Tasker allowed to display over other apps in Android Settings.
